# Mathematics for Computer Science (MIT 6.042J)

> Personal study archive for MIT 6.042J: the official English textbook PDF, a chapter/section hierarchy index, and a re-ordered scan of Chapter 18.

## Materials
- 教材/MIT-6.042J-官方教材-Mathematics-for-Computer-Science-2015(英文原书,920页).pdf: official textbook, 920 pages, English

- 目录/目录.docx: book table of contents

## Index
- 章节结构索引.md: chapter -> section -> subsection outline exported from the notes tree, for quick lookup
